You will regularly connect with colleagues across technical, analytical, and biological disciplines, and stay in close contact with teams spanning discovery and development of novel gene editing tools to therapeutic applications for clinical indications.
cond_0024.responsibilities:
Develop and optimize analysis workflows to analyze NGS data, including both whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES), targeted sequencing, and bulk/single cell RNA Seq
Develop novel Bioinformatics methods to answer platform and biological questions, and demonstrate validity of methods through prototypes and benchmarking using appropriate controls
Work closely and regularly with other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines
Proper documentation of code, workflows, and analyses including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings
Communicate actively with a broad audience with a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise and present results on a regular basis at various group meetings
cond_0024.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD and 3+ years post-PhD experience in bioinformatics, computational biology, and data science
Demonstrated experience in computational biology, CRISPR off target genomics, cancer genomics, and/or single-cell genomics
Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies including short- (Illumina) and long-read- (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing
Extensive experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines
Expert-level proficiency in relevant programming languages such as R and Python
Proficiency in tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake), and version control (e.g., git)
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently
Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with comfort presenting findings and walking colleagues through results
Preferred Requirements
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment
Benchling or Tableau experience

We are looking for a scientist with a background in genomics and sequencing technology to help design and analyze large datasets related to gene editing experiments. This is an opportunity to help build a therapeutics company from an early stage, with projects spanning discovery and development of novel gene editing tools to therapeutic applications for clinical indications.
cond_0072.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to develop and optimize analysis workflows for NGS data, including whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES), targeted sequencing, and bulk/single cell RNA Seq
Contribute to developing novel Bioinformatics methods to answer platform and biological questions, and help validate methods through prototypes and benchmarking using appropriate controls
Work with other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines
Maintain proper documentation of code, workflows, and analyses including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings
Share results regularly with a broad audience across a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise at various group meetings
cond_0072.requirements:
A PhD and 3+ years post-PhD experience in bioinformatics, computational biology, and data science.
Demonstrated experience in the field of computational biology, CRISPR off target genomics, cancer genomics, and/or single-cell genomics.
Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies including short- (Illumina) and long-read- (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing.
Extensive experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines.
Expert-level proficiency in relevant programming languages such as R and Python
Proficiency in tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake), and version control (e.g., git).
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently.
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing is preferred.
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills
Benchling or Tableau experience is a plus.
cond_0072.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

We are looking for a scientist with a background in genomics and sequencing technology to help design and analyze large datasets related to gene editing experiments. This is an opportunity to help build a therapeutics company from an early stage, working with colleagues across discovery and development of novel gene editing tools and therapeutic applications for clinical indications.
cond_0099.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to develop and optimize analysis workflows for NGS data, including whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES), targeted sequencing, and bulk/single cell RNA Seq
Collaborate on developing novel bioinformatics methods to answer platform and biological questions, and help validate methods through prototypes and benchmarking using appropriate controls
Work alongside other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines
Share responsibility for proper documentation of code, workflows, and analyses, including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings
Communicate findings to a broad audience with a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise, and present results regularly at various group meetings
cond_0099.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD and 3+ years post-PhD experience in bioinformatics, computational biology, or data science
Demonstrated experience in computational biology, CRISPR off-target genomics, cancer genomics, and/or single-cell genomics
Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies, including short-read (Illumina) and long-read (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing
Extensive experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines
Expert-level proficiency in R and Python
Proficiency in tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake) and version control (e.g., git)
Exceptional oral and written communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently
Benchling or Tableau experience

Develop and optimize analysis workflows to analyze NGS data, including both whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES), targeted sequencing, and bulk/single cell RNA Seq
Develop novel Bioinformatics methods to answer platform and biological questions, and demonstrate validity of methods through prototypes and benchmarking using appropriate controls
Work with other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines
Proper documentation of code, workflows, and analyses including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings
Communicate to a broad audience with a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise and present results on a regular basis at various group meetings
cond_0137.requirements:
A PhD and minimum 3 years post-PhD demonstrated expertise in bioinformatics, computational biology, and data science.
Proven track record in computational biology, CRISPR off target genomics, cancer genomics, and/or single-cell genomics.
Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies including short- (Illumina) and long-read- (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing.
Substantial experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines.
Expert-level proficiency in relevant programming languages such as R and Python.
Strong command of tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake), and version control (e.g., git).
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently.
Proficiency in AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills.
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing is preferred.
Benchling or Tableau experience is a plus.

cond_0162.intro: We are looking for a Scientist II, Computational Biology to join our team. The Bioinformatics and Computational Biology group at [Company name masked] works alongside all areas of the company. We are looking for a scientist with a background in genomics and sequencing technology to help design and analyze large datasets related to gene editing experiments. This is an opportunity to help build a therapeutics company from an early stage, with projects spanning discovery and development of novel gene editing tools to therapeutic applications for clinical indications.
cond_0162.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to develop and optimize analysis workflows for NGS data, including whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES), targeted sequencing, and bulk/single cell RNA Seq
Contribute to developing novel Bioinformatics methods to answer platform and biological questions, and help validate methods through prototypes and benchmarking using appropriate controls
Work with other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines
Maintain proper documentation of code, workflows, and analyses including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings
Share results regularly with a broad audience across a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise at various group meetings
cond_0162.requirements:
A PhD and 3+ years post-PhD experience in bioinformatics, computational biology, and data science.
Demonstrated experience in the field of computational biology, CRISPR off target genomics, cancer genomics, and/or single-cell genomics.
Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies including short- (Illumina) and long-read- (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing.
Extensive experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines.
Expert-level proficiency in relevant programming languages such as R and Python
Proficiency in tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake), and version control (e.g., git).
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently.
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing is preferred.
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills
Benchling or Tableau experience is a plus.

We are seeking curious, enthusiastic, competent, and self-motivated individuals with strong emotional intelligence to work in our company. This is an opportunity to help build a therapeutics company from an early stage. People usually grow into this kind of computational biology work over time as they build experience with genomics methods and learn from the data they encounter.
cond_0203.responsibilities:
Develop and optimize analysis workflows to analyze NGS data, including both whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES), targeted sequencing, and bulk/single cell RNA Seq
Develop novel Bioinformatics methods to answer platform and biological questions, and demonstrate validity of methods through prototypes and benchmarking using appropriate controls
Work with other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines
Proper documentation of code, workflows, and analyses including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings
Communicate to a broad audience with a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise and present results on a regular basis at various group meetings
cond_0203.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A PhD and 3+ years post-PhD experience in bioinformatics, computational biology, and data science
Demonstrated experience in the field of computational biology, CRISPR off target genomics, cancer genomics, and/or single-cell genomics
Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies including short- (Illumina) and long-read- (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing
Extensive experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines
Expert-level proficiency in relevant programming languages such as R and Python
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently
Exceptional oral and written communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake), and version control (e.g., git)
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment
Benchling or Tableau experience
cond_0203.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.

Work alongside other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines
Share responsibility for proper documentation of code, workflows, and analyses, including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings
Communicate findings to a broad audience with a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise, and present results regularly at various group meetings

Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies, including short-read (Illumina) and long-read (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing
Extensive experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines
Expert-level proficiency in R and Python
Proficiency in tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake) and version control (e.g., git)
Exceptional oral and written communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently
Benchling or Tableau experience

This is an opportunity to drive meaningful contributions at an early stage of building a therapeutics company.
cond_0620.responsibilities:
Develop and optimize analysis workflows to analyze NGS data, including whole genome sequencing (WGS/WES), targeted sequencing, and bulk/single cell RNA Seq.
Develop novel Bioinformatics methods to answer platform and biological questions, and demonstrate validity of methods through prototypes and benchmarking using appropriate controls.
Lead collaboration with other computational biologists and computational engineers to deliver and optimize production-level pipelines.
Own documentation of code, workflows, and analyses including study reports for nonclinical and clinical studies and regulatory filings.
Present results to a broad audience with a range of technical, analytical, and biological expertise at various group meetings.
cond_0620.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD and 3+ years post-PhD experience in bioinformatics, computational biology, and data science.
Demonstrated experience in computational biology, CRISPR off-target genomics, cancer genomics, and/or single-cell genomics.
Extensive expertise in analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing human genomics datasets generated by high-throughput sequencing technologies including short- (Illumina) and long-read- (e.g. PacBio and Oxford Nanopore) sequencing.
Extensive experience performing statistical analyses of large genomic datasets and validation of genomic pipelines.
Expert-level proficiency in relevant programming languages such as R and Python.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in tools for ensuring reproducibility of pipelines, such as workflow management systems (e.g., nextflow or snakemake), and version control (e.g., git).
Experience with CRISPR editing, base editing, or prime editing.
Familiarity with AWS, SQL, and working in a Unix environment.
Benchling or Tableau experience.
cond_0620.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
